fix: wrap project page queries in withAuthenticatedSession for RLS (#46)

Project page queries ran outside any authenticated session, meaning
PostgreSQL RLS policies evaluated current_setting('app.current_user_id', true)
as null/empty, causing FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY to block all rows on
the projects table. This surfaced as a 404 on any project page when
using PostgreSQL 16+ with strict RLS behavior.

Changes:
- Wrap getProjectsQuery call in withAuthenticatedSession() so the
  user ID is correctly set via set_config before RLS evaluation
- Wrap projectRequests lookup in withAuthenticatedSession() for the
  same reason
- Fix generateMetadata to also use withAuthenticatedSession when a
  user session is available
- Use a raw pool query for the bare existence check (the fallback
  after access is denied) to intentionally bypass FORCE RLS — the
  access control is already enforced at the application level by
  getProjectsQuery, so the existence check only needs to determine
  if the project exists at all, not whether the user can access it
